## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes. Include a small before-and-after example when helpful.

## Validation

List checks actually run, their results, and platforms tested. State any relevant checks not run.

## Compatibility and documentation

Describe changes to CLI behavior, configuration, diagnostics, or supported syntax. Link a related issue if one exists.

- [ ] Usage documentation and known limitations reflect the change.
- [ ] No secrets or private repository content are included.
